name: Hiiragi
source:
A blind singer who is invited as a national guest. 
He is gentle and smiles all the time, but has a sharp intuition.
He can know the inside of people just from hearing their voice, and also is a gentle man who can understand them.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE092288.html]DLsite English[/url]]
